newsitem.title: USA: TAP Holdings gets U.S. FDA approval for Lupron.
newsitem.headline: TAP Holdings gets U.S. FDA approval for Lupron.

text.p: TAP Holdings Inc said Friday it received market clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Lupron Depot-4 Month 30 mg drug to treat advanced prostate cancer.
TAP is a joint venture between Abbott Laboratories Inc and Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd.
The drug allows patients to receive only one injection of Lupron Depot-4 Month every 16 weeks for treatment, it added.

Lupron Depot is a member of a class of drugs known as gonadtropin releasing hormone analogs. Lupron Depot-4 Month 30 mg inhibits the production of testosterone, which may play a significant role in the growth of prostate cancer, TAP said.
Decreasing testosterone levels in the body also may alleviate bone pain and some urinary problems that may be associated with metastatic prostate cancer, TAP said.
